title: NoteForge AI Knowledge Engine
shortDescription: AI-powered Markdown knowledge base with vector embeddings, instant hybrid search, and graph visualization.
description: NoteForge AI is an intelligent workspace that converts messy unstructured notes into organized knowledge graphs. Powered by Gemini 1.5 Pro and local Qdrant vector index, it provides contextual search, auto-tagging, and automated flashcard generation.
myContributions: Implemented Qdrant vector similarity indexing with sub-50ms query response time.
Built interactive Cytoscape knowledge graph view for visualizing bi-directional note links.
Integrated Gemini 1.5 Pro stream parsing for real-time document summarization.
architectureDiagram:
graph TD
    NextJS["Next.js App Router UI"] -->|"REST / WebSocket"| FastAPI["FastAPI Microservice"]
    FastAPI -->|"Embedding Generation"| Gemini["Gemini Embeddings API"]
    FastAPI -->|"Vector Similarity Search"| Qdrant["Qdrant Vector DB"]
    FastAPI -->|"Relational Storage"| Postgres["PostgreSQL Database"]
    NextJS -->|"Graph Visualization"| Cytoscape["Cytoscape.js Knowledge Graph"]

apiEndpoints.description: Create note and generate vector embedding chunks
Executes BM25 keyword + Qdrant cosine similarity search
Returns node & edge payload for knowledge graph visualization

keyModules.name: Vector Chunking Engine
keyModules.description: Splits markdown headers into semantic token chunks with overlap

challenges: Balancing chunk size precision vs context window retention during similarity search.
Optimizing Cytoscape graph layout render times for 1,000+ notes.
learnings: Hybrid BM25 + Vector ranking outperforms pure embedding search by 35% on technical queries.
futureRoadmap: Add local Llama 3 offline embedding fallback.
Implement real-time multiplayer document editing with Yjs.
